verdict.rationale: The evidence shows automatic research-report generation, API-driven reports and systematic reviews, and email Alerts. None of it documents a long one-off job that keeps running unattended and then notifies the analyst when its result is ready. Instant email alerts cover newly found papers, and Routines are a recurring monitoring feature that hands over analyses, so neither is completion notification for a single job.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready
